answers.core:
There are lots and lots of fields in the Debug/GDScript section, and it seems like one would expect these to show up there. I also don't think an add-on would be able to help with this in a reasonable way.

This technically falls under https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/9280, however that proposal is more ambitious and asks for a customizable linter, whereas this proposal asks for a very specific kind of warning.
